_comment: Static Firestore collections seeded by scripts/importData.ts (production) and e2e/helpers/seed-emulator.mjs (emulator). One list so the two cannot drift. Paths are relative to app/. Supplements and articles come from src/data — the same files the app bundles as its offline fallback (src/services/localContentFallback.ts) — because the repo-root copies lacked the en/ar/tn dose and precaution text and carried older pregnancy_safety values. Guarded by __tests__/seedData.test.ts.
